{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm: revenue has commas
print("Number of revenue entries with commas:", df['revenue'].str.contains(',', regex=False).sum())

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check the cleaned column
df['revenue_clean'].describe()"}
